expression: The vans park adjacent to the building with a red roof.
program:
def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    building_patches = image_patch.find("building with a red roof")
    if not building_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    building = building_patches[0]
    building_center_x = (building.left + building.right) / 2
    building_center_y = (building.lower + building.upper) / 2
    
    van_patches = image_patch.find("van")
    adjacent_vans = []
    
    for van in van_patches:
        van_center_x = (van.left + van.right) / 2
        van_center_y = (van.lower + van.upper) / 2
        
        if abs(van_center_x - building_center_x) < abs(building.width / 2 + van.width / 2) and \
           abs(van_center_y - building_center_y) < abs(building.height / 2 + van.height / 2):
            adjacent_vans.append(van)
    
    return adjacent_vans
